onTeardown: seq[proc ()] = @[]
pkgRequireHook: PkgRequireHook = nil
File-backed require("pkg/...") and relative requires go through this hook (set by pkg/loader). Nil in tests that do not need it. 
stdRequireHook: StdRequireHook = nil
File-backed require("std/<name>") for JS-based modules (set by pkg/stdsync). Nil in tests that do not need it.
